messages:
Mia Chen: Quick UX reg — noticed the compact console modal sits too close to the breadcrumb on narrow screens, header visually collides. Spotted on staging.
Sam Patel: I see it. Probably a spacing token regression from the density pass. Can you attach screenshot?
Mia Chen: uploaded screenshot to the thread (staging link). The breadcrumb separator and modal top look merged.
Lucía Rivera: That came in when we tightened modal vertical padding to improve density for lists. Breadcrumbs still use the old gap token. We probably transitioned from spacing.compact-3 to spacing.compact-1 in different components.
Arjun Iyer: Current rules show: ```css
.modal--compact { padding-top: var(--spacing-compact-1); }
.breadcrumb { gap: var(--spacing-compact-3); }
```
Arjun Iyer: Suggest adding a middle token `spacing.compact-2` and using it for both breadcrumb gap and modal top so the spacing reads consistently across components.
Mia Chen: Also, noticed toast stacks occasionally overlap the breadcrumb area on pages with a persistent shell footer. Toasts are anchored to viewport bottom and ignore shell bottom.
Sam Patel: Toast container uses safe-area but not `--shell-bottom`. We can update to `bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + var(--shell-bottom))` or move the toast into the main content slot so it respects shell layout.
design-bot: lint: missing token "spacing.compact-2" in tokens.json. Recommend adding the token and referencing it in both breadcrumb and modal (lint-id: token-missing-19421).
Lucía Rivera: Plan: 1) add `spacing.compact-2` to tokens; 2) swap breadcrumb gap and modal top padding to that token; 3) update toast anchoring to include `--shell-bottom`. That should address both collision and overlap cases.
Oliver Park: I'll take the toast change. I'll update the container styles and run visual diffs across the main shells. Assigning to @Oliver Park.
Mia Chen: Sam, can you handle the token addition and modal update? Please include an aria check — I noticed screen readers may announce "dialog" twice when breadcrumb is present. Might be an `aria-labelledby` mis-targeting.
Sam Patel: I'll do both. Draft PR will include: ```css
/* new token */
:root { --spacing-compact-2: 12px; }
.modal--compact { padding-top: var(--spacing-compact-2); }
.breadcrumb { gap: var(--spacing-compact-2); }
/* ensure aria-labelledby references only modal title */
```
Arjun Iyer: Accessibility nit to add to PR checklist: verify modal markup doesn't include breadcrumb IDs in `aria-labelledby` or `aria-describedby`. Screen reader should only focus modal title and body.
Oliver Park: Toast PR ready, running CI screenshots. Using `bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + var(--shell-bottom))` and moving container inside `.app-shell` where appropriate. Will post diffs. :thumbsup: 
Sam Patel: PR opened for tokens + modal + aria fix (staging link included). Visual tests posted.
Mia Chen: Reviewed both PRs, spot-checked staging on narrow/wide. Spacing looks consistent, toasts no longer overlay the breadcrumb or shell. Screen reader announcement fixed per a11y regression test.
Mia Chen: Merged changes after minor tweaks. Thanks all — closing this thread.
